'''Brenebon''' soup or '''bruinebonensoep''' is a [[kidney bean]] [[soup]] commonly found in the Eastern [[Indonesia]],<ref name="FAO"/> more often specifically associated with [[Manado cuisine]] of [[North Sulawesi]].<ref name="Resep-Masakan">{{cite web | title = Resep Sup Brenebon (bruine bonen soep) asli dari Belanda | work = Resep Masakan | url = http://resepmasakan.travelizta.com/2015/03/resep-sup-brenebon-bruine-bonen-soep.html | language = Indonesian | access-date = 2016-05-06 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20180719131751/http://resepmasakan.travelizta.com/2015/03/resep-sup-brenebon-bruine-bonen-soep.html | archive-date = 2018-07-19 | url-status = dead }}</ref> The soup is made from kidney beans with vegetables served in [[broth]] seasoned with [[garlic]], [[Black pepper|pepper]], and other spices.<ref name="Bruine-bonensoep">{{cite web | title = 'Bruine-bonensoep, Sup brenebon', van Lonny | work = Albert Heijn | date = 18 May 2015 | url = http://www.ah.nl/kookschrift/recept?id=159106 | language = Dutch}}</ref>
